description: This file defines a Perl module Git::SVN::Memoize::YAML that implements a class for tying a hash to a YAML file to persist memoized data. It includes methods for loading, storing, and destroying the cache, as well as typical hash behavior.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Memoize::YAML
classes.description: A class to tie a hash to a YAML file for persistent caching in the Memoize system.

methods.name: TIEHASH
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tied hash object, loading data from the YAML file if it exists.

methods.name: STORE
methods.description: Stores a value in the hash associated with a key.

methods.name: FETCH
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the hash by key.

methods.name: EXISTS
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the hash.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Dumps the current hash to the YAML file, persisting the cache.

methods.name: SCALAR
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the hash.

methods.name: FIRSTKEY
methods.description: Returns a placeholder string, as this module does not fully implement iterator methods.

methods.name: NEXTKEY
methods.description: Returns undef, as this module does not implement hash iteration.
